item.title: Gen Z and Millennials Run for Congress in Record Numbers, Few Reach November
item.description: Gen Z and millennials launched their largest effort yet to reshape Congress, but about seven in 10 were out by early September, a new report finds.

item.title: Schumer's final fight for Senate control
item.description: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer is close to leading his party to midterm victory and reclaiming the majority leader role.

item.title: US unprepared for space warfare consequences
item.description: The future of war is in outer space, and the U.S. is unprepared for the fallout. A space warfare outbreak would cripple the globe.

item.title: CEO confidence turns negative
item.description: Data from The Conference Board and The Business Council shows CEO confidence in the U.S. economy sank into negative territory earlier.
